customer-acme: Hi—trying to submit a resale certificate for invoice INV-2048. API returns VAT_VALIDATION_FAILED and the invoice is on hold. We uploaded the PDF and added PO PO-889. Can someone check?

anna (Support): On it — can you paste the VAT ID you're submitting and confirm country?

customer-acme: VAT ID: DE123456789-01 (branch suffix). Country: DE. VIES lookup shows valid for DE123456789, but your UI rejects with 'branch suffix not allowed'.

mike (Billing): We normally require the company-level VAT (no branch suffix) for reverse charge. That said, we do accept national resale certs in some cases. Did you upload a national certificate PDF or just the VAT id?

customer-acme: Uploaded the national resale certificate PDF from our accounting team — it shows the branch code '-01' on the doc.

tim (Eng): Can you share validator logs or the raw payload? @vat-bot please paste the last validation response for that VAT id.

vat-bot: VIES response: status=valid, id=DE123456789, name=ACME GmbH branch:01. Internal validator: normalized_id=DE123456789 (suffix stripped); input contained 'DE123456789-01' -> rejected due to strict regex ^DE[0-9]{9}$.

tim (Eng): Looks like a normalization inconsistency: we strip suffix for VIES, but later compare the original input against a stricter regex and fail. I can push a small change to allow suffixes in input (still store canonical id as DE123456789).

anna (Support): @zara (Legal) — any legal issue accepting a national certificate that references a branch suffix for reverse charge? Customer says their tax authority treats branch as part of the same legal entity.

zara (Legal): We can accept national resale certificates if they clearly identify the legal entity and match the invoice payee. Branch suffix is acceptable if the document ties the branch back to the main legal entity. We need manual evidence review: please attach the PDF + company registry extract. We'll record approval in the audit trail.

mike (Billing): For immediate unblock I can do a manual override to clear the invoice hold once Legal signs off. Please attach the PDF and a registry link.

customer-acme: Attached PDF (link: https://files.example/acme/resale-INV-2048.pdf) and registry extract: https://handbook.example/registry/DE/ACME-12345. Need this cleared — PO deadline tomorrow.

anna (Support): Thanks — adding to manual reviews and pinging Legal. ETA ~2 business hours. Interim workaround: submit the VAT id without the '-01' in the API and upload the same PDF; that passes the automated check and will get you unstuck faster.

tim (Eng): I'm rolling a small validator tweak to accept input suffixes in the onboarding path and keep canonical storage normalized. Patch CL-4728. No downtime expected. Will monitor logs for false positives.

zara (Legal): Received the docs. They clearly identify the legal entity and link to the registry extract. Approved for reverse charge. Please record decision and audit note.

mike (Billing): Done — invoice INV-2048 unheld and processed. Customer notified. :white_check_mark: 

customer-acme: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the fast help.
